title: Identification of YL064 as a novel inhibitor of ATXN3 to suppress tumor growth and metastasis by promoting degradation of oncogenic substrates.
authors: Zhang, Zhenge; Bai, Wenhui; Tan, Yayue; Li, Guanyi; Zhang, Youping; Wu, Wenxuan; Zhu, Chujiao; Liu, Xingyu; Zhang, Manyu; Lei, Hu; Xu, Hanzhang; Yang, Li; Liu, Ligen; Zhao, Yaxue; Yao, Zhujun; Zhu, Qi; Wang, Yingying; Wu, Yingli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子YL064抑制去泛素化酶ATXN3的抗肿瘤作用，核心是蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ATXN3 has recently emerged as a pro-oncogenic deubiquitinating enzyme (DUB) involved in the progression of multiple cancers, including breast and prostate cancer. However, the therapeutic potential of targeting ATXN3 remains largely unexplored due to the lack of effective inhibitors. In this study, we performed an Ub-AMC-based high-throughput screening assay using full-length ATXN3 and identified YL064, a derivative of the natural product sinomenine isolated from Sinomenium acutum, as a novel ATXN3 inhibitor. Direct interaction between YL064 and ATXN3 was confirmed by thermal shift assay, cellular thermal shift assay, surface plasmon resonance, and molecular docking analysis. Functionally, YL064 suppressed cancer cell proliferation, induced cell-cycle arrest, and reduced metastatic potential. Mechanistically, YL064 inhibited ATXN3 deubiquitinating activity and promoted the ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of ATXN3 substrates, including KLF4 and YAP. Furthermore, YL064 significantly inhibited tumor growth in an orthotopic breast cancer model in vivo. Collectively, our findings establish YL064 as a promising ATXN3 inhibitor that targets the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway to exert anti-tumor effects, highlighting its potential as a novel therapeutic agent for ATXN3-driven cancers.
abstract_zh: ATXN3 近期被确认为一种促癌去泛素化酶（deubiquitinating enzyme, DUB），参与包括乳腺癌和前列腺癌在内的多种癌症的进展。然而，由于缺乏有效抑制剂，靶向ATXN3的治疗潜力在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在本研究中，我们利用全长ATXN3进行了基于Ub-AMC的高通量筛选实验，并鉴定出YL064——一种从青风藤（Sinomenium acutum）中分离的天然产物青藤碱的衍生物——作为新型ATXN3抑制剂。通过热位移分析、细胞热位移分析、表面等离子体共振和分子对接分析，确认了YL064与ATXN3之间的直接相互作用。在功能上，YL064抑制了癌细胞增殖，诱导细胞周期阻滞，并降低了转移潜力。在机制上，YL064抑制了ATXN3的去泛素化活性，并促进了ATXN3底物（包括KLF4和YAP）的泛素化及蛋白酶体降解。此外，在体内原位乳腺癌模型中，YL064显著抑制了肿瘤生长。总体而言，我们的研究结果确立了YL064作为一种有前景的ATXN3抑制剂，通过靶向泛素-蛋白酶体途径发挥抗肿瘤作用，突显了其作为ATXN3驱动癌症新型治疗药物的潜力。
